triage_tips[0].quote: Pair this with the audit log cleared event on the same host.

what_it_is.quote: wevtutil.exe run with the cl (clear-log) argument.

esql.query: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\wevtutil.exe") and (process.command_line like "* cl *" or process.command_line like "* clear-log *")

kql.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FolderPath endswith "\\wevtutil.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains " cl " or ProcessCommandLine contains " clear-log ")

title: Event logs cleared with wevtutil
triage_tips: Pair this with the audit log cleared event on the same host.
Known false positive: log rotation scripts; check whether one ran.
Rule level is high; treat as likely defense evasion until ruled out.
what_it_is: Detects wevtutil.exe run with the cl (clear-log) argument, i.e. Windows event logs being cleared.
why_it_flags: Clearing event logs is tagged defense evasion (T1070.001); the rule matches wevtutil.exe whose command line contains ' cl ' or ' clear-log '.
